## Summary

Taiyo Yuden is a Japanese electronic components maker founded in 1950 in Tokyo, headquartered in Kyobashi, Chuo-ku, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange as 6976 and a Nikkei 225 constituent; its products include ceramic capacitors, inductors, ceramic chip antennas, SAW filters and Bluetooth modules [2]. The IEEE registry lists six MA-L blocks at its Takasaki, Gunma address under three spellings of the name [1].

A MAC in a Taiyo Yuden block is most likely the Bluetooth module inside another company's product, not a Taiyo Yuden device [2][4]. Its EYSHSNZWZ Bluetooth 5 module is built on Nordic's nRF52832 with 512 kB flash and 64 kB RAM in 8.35 by 3.25 by 0.9 mm [3], and the 2020 EYSSSNZWW uses Nordic's nRF52805 for smart wristbands, pens, glasses, single-use medical products and small IoT sensor nodes [4].

No source in hand names the end products carrying these modules, so the found-in list is empty; no randomization documentation or security advisory naming Taiyo Yuden was found, and the FCC ID databases could not be consulted, so no grantee code is listed [2][3][4].
